scope: Actual provider and protected card form in Chromium with synthetic authentication, no real sessions
results: same-user focus/SIGNED_IN preserves the real card dialog and all typed fields
token refresh and same-account profile updates preserve drafts
30 second permissions refresh preserves the open form
real organization change clears the previous company draft
sign-out removes the protected form immediately
account change never inherits the previous account draft
revoked administrator permission still closes the protected screen
